summary.text: THERMTECH AS is a private limited company registered in Paradis, founded 2002-02-27. THERMTECH AS tilbyr renoveringstjenester og teknologisk kunnskap og løsninger vedrørende miljø og forurensningsspørsmål, samt design, bygging og implementering av tekniske løsninger for separasjon og resirkulering av avfall. It was previously named TRANSNATIONAL WASTE MANAGEMENT NORWAY AS until 2007-11-03. Its main industry code is 71.129: other technical consultancy. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 41 815 591 NOK and the annual result was 2 068 525 NOK; operating income was up from 37 409 096 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 15 556 NOK in 2024 to 2 068 525 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 6 229 341 NOK in 2024 to 6 365 720 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is thermtech.no, which links to its LinkedIn profile. The registered employee count went from 9 on 2025-11-13 to 10 on 2026-10-14. The register's most recent update was on 2026-10-14 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
